tasks.instruction:
Add optional fractionDigits?: 0 | 3 to FormatISO9075Options and formatISO9075. Omitted or undefined means 0 and preserves current output. With 3 append exactly three local milliseconds digits after seconds in complete and time representations, both basic and extended formats. Date-only output must not include fractions. Reject any non-undefined option value other than numeric 0 or 3 with RangeError, even for date-only output. Preserve Invalid Date rejection, date construction context, local date/time fields and input immutability. Modify only src/formatISO9075/index.ts.
Run npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 --pool=forks src/formatISO9075/test.ts src/formatISODuration/test.ts src/eachDayOfInterval/test.ts and npm run types after your last source edit. Keep existing tests, dependencies, package manifests, generated files and unrelated behavior unchanged. Only change the specified implementation file. Do not retrieve published solutions, reference patches or benchmark verifier source. Work independently from this checkout.

Add exported FormatISODurationOptions with optional omitZeroUnits?: boolean and an optional second options argument to formatISODuration. Omitted, undefined or false preserves current exact output. With true omit numeric-zero and missing components, retain nonzero years/months/days followed by nonzero hours/minutes/seconds in existing order, emit T only when a time component is present, and return PT0S when all components are zero/missing. Preserve values of nonzero components, including negative or fractional values historically accepted; do not mutate duration/options. Ignore weeks as before. Reject every non-undefined omitZeroUnits value other than boolean true/false with RangeError, including an empty duration. Modify only src/formatISODuration/index.ts.
Run npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 --pool=forks src/formatISO9075/test.ts src/formatISODuration/test.ts src/eachDayOfInterval/test.ts and npm run types after your last source edit. Keep existing tests, dependencies, package manifests, generated files and unrelated behavior unchanged. Only change the specified implementation file. Do not retrieve published solutions, reference patches or benchmark verifier source. Work independently from this checkout.

Add optional maxDates?: number to EachDayOfIntervalOptions and eachDayOfInterval. Omitted or undefined preserves current behavior. Accept only finite nonnegative integers and throw RangeError for any other non-undefined option value before existing early empty returns. Zero returns an empty array. A positive limit returns the prefix of the existing ordered result, equivalent to the legacy result sliced to maxDates, including reversed intervals and negative/positive/zero step handling. Preserve local-midnight dates across DST, context/date subtype inference, input interval/date/options immutability and all other behavior. Modify only src/eachDayOfInterval/index.ts.
Run npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 --pool=forks src/formatISO9075/test.ts src/formatISODuration/test.ts src/eachDayOfInterval/test.ts and npm run types after your last source edit. Keep existing tests, dependencies, package manifests, generated files and unrelated behavior unchanged. Only change the specified implementation file. Do not retrieve published solutions, reference patches or benchmark verifier source. Work independently from this checkout.
